en.badge: A mobile IDE for Android & iOS
en.title: Away from your desk.
en.intro: NimoteCode brings code editing, SSH terminals, and AI agents to your phone and tablet. Connect to your development machine, make a change, run tests, and review the result.
en.caption: IDE, Terminal, and AI. One project, wherever you work.
en.heading: From a change to a checked result.
en.description: Your files, commands, and AI share one project. Switch how you work without starting over.
features: See the project. Focus on the change.
Bring project files, code editing, and Git review together. Work across tabs or split panes, then inspect the diff before committing.
Give commands and project tools room to work.
Run builds, tests, and scripts over SSH or supported Android Local Linux. Adaptive terminal panes, command history, and zoom make mobile command work easier.
Turn a goal into a plan you can review.
Let an agent read your project, propose a plan, and carry out multi-step tasks. Review the plan, add follow-up instructions, and inspect tool output and code changes.
en.demoCopy: Watch the AI Agent work through a project, or switch to the workspace walkthrough.
en.compareTitle: Choose mobile tools for the work you do.
en.compareCopy: Compare workspaces, code editing, Git, AI and platform support, with configuration and payment requirements documented for each tool.
resources: Your first workspace, step by step.
Practical ways to develop on mobile.
Selected tutorials, practical blog posts and official references.
en.ctaCopy: Start with a local folder or connect to your development machine over SSH.
blogArticles: MOBILE DEVELOPMENT
Mobile SSH & AI tools: seven options
Compare terminal access, host agents and integrated mobile development by task.
AI CODING
Can an AI Agent Really Code From a Phone?
Plan, edit, run and commit real changes from a phone over SSH.
REMOTE DEVELOPMENT

Connect to Mac and Linux without a public IP or port forwarding.

ko.intro: NimoteCode는 코드 편집, SSH 터미널, AI 에이전트를 휴대폰과 태블릿에 담았습니다. 개발 컴퓨터에 연결해 코드를 수정하고 테스트를 실행한 뒤 결과를 확인하세요.

Agent가 프로젝트를 읽고 계획을 제안하며 여러 단계의 작업을 수행합니다. 계획 검토, 추가 지시, 도구 출력과 코드 변경 확인을 이어가세요.

es.badge: Un IDE móvil para Android e iOS
es.title: Lejos de tu escritorio.
es.intro: NimoteCode reúne edición de código, terminales SSH y agentes de IA en tu móvil y tablet. Conecta con tu equipo, modifica código, ejecuta pruebas y revisa el resultado.
es.caption: IDE, Terminal e IA. Un mismo proyecto.
es.heading: Del cambio al resultado, en un proyecto.
es.description: Tus archivos, comandos e IA comparten el proyecto. Cambia de modo sin empezar de nuevo.
features: Explora el proyecto y concéntrate en el cambio.
Reúne archivos, edición de código y revisión de Git. Trabaja con pestañas o paneles divididos y revisa el diff antes de confirmar cambios.
Más espacio para comandos y herramientas.
Ejecuta compilaciones, pruebas y scripts por SSH o Android Local Linux compatible. Usa paneles adaptables, historial de comandos y zoom.
Convierte un objetivo en un plan revisable.
El agente lee el proyecto, propone un plan y ejecuta tareas de varios pasos. Revisa el plan, envía instrucciones adicionales y comprueba las salidas y los cambios.
es.demoCopy: Mira al agente de IA trabajar en un proyecto o cambia a la demo del espacio de trabajo.
es.compareTitle: Elige herramientas móviles para tu trabajo.
es.compareCopy: Compara espacios de trabajo, edición de código, Git, IA y plataformas compatibles. Consulta los requisitos de configuración y pago de cada herramienta en la comparación detallada.
